title: Reports
subtitle: Inspect pricing books, gateway profitability, cost allocation, cache savings, and idle keys.
standardPricesDesc: Override the actual-side datasheet with internal mark-ups. Each row carries an effective_from so historical windows pick the right snapshot.
gatewayDeltaDesc: Compare the gateway's billed spend against the standard price book for any window. Negative deltas are gateway losses; positive deltas are margin.
costDesc: Monthly team / member / virtual-key split. The summary card shows observed total + projected spend + risk level.
cacheSavingsDesc: How many requests were served from the semantic cache in the window and what they would have cost.
budgetForecastDesc: Predict when each budget runs dry from hourly spend snapshots.
idleKeysDesc: Virtual keys that haven't been used in N days. Includes brand-new keys that have never been shared.

cacheSavings.title: Cache savings
cacheSavings.subtitle: Window-scoped cache hit requests + estimated savings, plus the in-process tracker.
cacheSavings.processDesc: In-memory cache hit rate since the gateway boot. The same numbers /api/cache/stats exposes.

cost.title: Cost allocation
cost.subtitle: Team / member / virtual-key split, top dimensions, and forecast.
cost.rowsDesc: The first 50 rows by cost. Click into the team pages for member / virtual-key breakdown.
cost.rowsEmpty: No cost data in this window.
cost.note1: Forecast uses a flat 1.4× multiplier on observed spend; budget_snapshots power the per-budget projection endpoint.
cost.note2: Cost is computed from the log store's standard_prices re-pricing, independent of the gateway's actual cost.
cost.note3: team_owner and member views never include cost_actual or delta — those are admin-only reconciliation numbers.

budgetForecast.title: Budget forecast
budgetForecast.subtitle: Per-budget predicted exhaustion time from hourly budget snapshots.
budgetForecast.noProjectionReason: No snapshots yet — projection will populate after the first hourly sample.
budgetForecast.note1: Projection fits a line through the trailing hourly budget_snapshots. With fewer than 2 samples it falls back to the current used/max percentage.

idleKeys.title: Idle keys
idleKeys.subtitle: Virtual keys that haven't been used for N days. Includes brand-new keys that have never been called.
idleKeys.thresholdDesc: Show keys idle for at least N days. Capped at 365.
idleKeys.empty: No idle keys match this threshold. Great — everything is healthy.

standardPrices.title: Standard prices
standardPrices.subtitle: Internal price book used by gateway-delta and team reconciliation reports.
standardPrices.sheetDesc: Input and output costs are per 1M tokens. Cache-read and cost-per-request are optional.
standardPrices.deleteConfirmDesc: Remove {{provider}}/{{model}} from the standard price book. Historical reports keep using the snapshot they pinned at the time.

toast.synced: Synced {{count}} rows from the actual-side datasheet.

standardPrices.empty: No standard-price rows. Run Sync to seed from the actual-side datasheet, or click New price to add one.

gatewayDelta.title: Gateway delta
gatewayDelta.subtitle: Actual vs. standard cost across providers and models.
gatewayDelta.coverageDesc: Share of actual spend that the standard price book can explain.
